item.title: How to translate your own book into 101 languages ​​in minutes
item.description: The Gemini tool and the standard translator in Google Docs have allowed me to scale texts to a global level almost instantly and at minimal cost. Thanks to my own batch processing script, I offer a service to quickly translate your document into over 100 languages ​​without manual intervention. Why it works: ⬧ Ultra-fast: 101 languages ​​in 15 minutes (≈ 9 seconds per language for a 48,000-word document). ⬧ Scalability: Preserve headings, lists, tables, and images. ⬧ Savings: The cost of translating a book into 101 languages ​​is only about €5 / $6. Below you will find complete instructions and terms for ordering the 101st translation of your work.
